full_judgment:
17. The other decision referred to by the learned Advocate for the opposite parties on the point of remand of the case to the trial Court namely, Anwar Hussain and another vs SL Franklin and others reported in AIR 1958 (Allahabad) 562, it may be pointed out that the principle of law enunciated in the said decision cannot be disputed but the fact remains that in the instant case we do not find anything to show that the trial Court has ever failed to determine any material issue in the case rather, it appears that all the issues involved in the suit has rightly been framed, considered and decided with reference to the evidence and materials on record by the trial Court but the appellate Court erroneously found fault with the same without considering the evidence on record. For the reason discussed above, it appears further that the impugned Judgment and decree of reversal as passed by the appellate Court below suffer from error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. 

 18. In the result, the Rule is made absolute without any order as to costs and the impugned Judgment and decree of reversal dated 5-7-1998 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge now Joint District Judge, Mymensingh in other Class Appeal No. 128 of 1994 are hereby set aside and the Judgment and decree dated 23-3-1994 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Additional Court, Mymensingh in Other Class Suit No. 70 of 1992 are hereby upheld.
